name: complex
description: A complete complex number arithmetic library. Provides a Complex class with operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide, modulus (abs), argument (angle), conjugate, power (integer and complex), square root, exponential, natural log, and trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan) all working on complex numbers.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when performing signal processing math, solving differential equations, working with Fourier transforms, or doing any computation requiring numbers with real and imaginary components.
